sloka: गङ्गायास्तु परे पारे वाल्मीकेस्तु महात्मनः ।आश्रमो दिव्यसङ्काशस्तमसातीरमाश्रितः ।। ७.४५.१७ ॥
transliteration: gaṅgāyāstu pare pāre vālmīkestu mahātmanaḥ ।āśramo divyasaṅkāśastamasātīramāśritaḥ ।। 7.45.17 ॥

translations.english: On the other bank of the Ganga, there is the divine-looking hermitage of the great sage Valmiki, situated on the banks of the Tamasa river.
